query:
SELECT product, milestone_name, DATE(milestone_date) as date, WEEK(milestone_date) as week
FROM milestones 
WHERE milestone_type = 'gtm_milestones'
AND milestone_date >= CURDATE()
AND milestone_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
ORDER BY milestone_date
LIMIT 20;
